item.text: {"critiques":[{"candidate_id":"release-policy-baseline-v1","result":{"findings":[{"claim_ids":["x1"],"evidence":"release_policy.py:13 compares digests with != rather than hmac.compare_digest.","finding_id":"f1","severity":"blocking","summary":"Digest equality does not use the required comparison function."},{"claim_ids":["x2","x3"],"evidence":"release_policy.py:17 accepts path 'docs-old/file' under root 'docs' through a raw string prefix check; it performs no POSIX path normalization or validation.","finding_id":"f2","severity":"blocking","summary":"Invalid paths and paths outside a root can be accepted."},{"claim_ids":["x4"],"evidence":"release_policy.py:17 checks only change['path']; a rename whose source is outside the allowed roots can pass.","finding_id":"f3","severity":"blocking","summary":"Rename sources are not checked."},{"claim_ids":["x5"],"evidence":"release_policy.py:15-17 neither validates roots nor checks record actions; missing 'path' raises KeyError instead of returning False.","finding_id":"f4","severity":"blocking","summary":"Malformed inputs and unknown actions do not consistently fail closed."}],"schema_version":1,"verdict":"changes_requested"}},{"candidate_id":"refactor-baseline-v1","result":{"findings":[{"claim_ids":["x1"],"evidence":"routing.py:15-20 duplicates routing logic inside legacy_route instead of calling route_request.","finding_id":"f1","severity":"blocking","summary":"legacy_route does not delegate to the sole routing implementation."},{"claim_ids":["c1","s1"],"evidence":"routing.py:24 and routing.py:28 call legacy_route; both production entry points are required to call route_request directly.","finding_id":"f2","severity":"blocking","summary":"dispatch and dispatch_batch still use the superseded route."}],"schema_version":1,"verdict":"changes_requested"}}],"schema_version":1}
